rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b (2026-10-04): 13 input configurations (shared and multi-direction goal field, bge and gte-modernbert for statements and documents, dedupe incl. cross-agent echoes, style residualization) and two native tests (G21 pair-level reading DiD, G41 one kickoff two rooms) with dated predictions; per-period estimates written. #14 confirmatory not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The literal swarm-level step fails in all configurations (model-dependent reason: none under bge, a generic kickoff-day-sized step under gte). The pair-level version passes in both models (reading pulls the reader toward the owner by ~0.03; weaker after style residualization) and #41 shows room-local divergence after a shared kickoff: D and E move to 1. Single period, no holdout.
rationale.usefulness: For forecast aggregation: an independent-draft phase protects no diversity (alignment is set at kickoff), and coupling enters pairwise through what agents read, so reading graphs, not phase schedules, are the lever to watch. Small effects, one week.
